g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: HARDWARE REVIEW DRAFT - NOT RELEASED FOR PCB

g.desc: HARDWARE REVIEW DRAFT - NOT RELEASED FOR PCB

g.text: CONTROLLER | 4.75-5.25 V header input | common-ground minimum core

g.desc: CONTROLLER | 4.75-5.25 V header input | common-ground minimum core

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: 64 contacts: 52 MCU signal pads + 2 core 5V feed + 2 core 3V3 reference + CTRL_READY + 7 GND.

g.desc: 64 contacts: 52 MCU signal pads + 2 core 5V feed + 2 core 3V3 reference + CTRL_READY + 7 GND.

g.text: All MCU GPIOs are exposed by port name. PG10 stays NRST; PF0/PF1 share optional HSE; PB8 shares BOOT.

g.desc: All MCU GPIOs are exposed by port name. PG10 stays NRST; PF0/PF1 share optional HSE; PB8 shares BOOT.

g.text: PC7 is RUN_ARM when plugged into this power base. CTRL_READY = Schmitt-reset-ok AND PC7; default LOW.

g.desc: PC7 is RUN_ARM when plugged into this power base. CTRL_READY = Schmitt-reset-ok AND PC7; default LOW.

g.text: Application ABZ / SPI / UART / SWD / CAN / LEDs / ADC filters all reside on the power baseboard.

g.desc: Application ABZ / SPI / UART / SWD / CAN / LEDs / ADC filters all reside on the power baseboard.

g.text: 60x60 POWER ABOVE / 60x60 CORE BELOW. Core TOP male -> power BOTTOM socket. Board gap / thermal / button access pending PCB.

g.desc: 60x60 POWER ABOVE / 60x60 CORE BELOW. Core TOP male -> power BOTTOM socket. Board gap / thermal / button access pending PCB.

g.text: Standalone core: regulated 4.75-5.25V at J101 pins1/3 and GND. Do not parallel independent 5V sources.

g.desc: Standalone core: regulated 4.75-5.25V at J101 pins1/3 and GND. Do not parallel independent 5V sources.

g.text: 3V3 reference is core -> base clamps / fault pull-up / SWD sense only. Never parallel base and core regulators.

g.desc: 3V3 reference is core -> base clamps / fault pull-up / SWD sense only. Never parallel base and core regulators.
